title: Formal Research Hypotheses for Candidate 5 (Phase 7 Evaluation)
context: Formulated following the rigorous gate-based elimination of Families A, B, D, and E, establishing Family C (Recency-Weighted Threshold Offset Proximity) as the sole mathematically and architecturally defensible candidate.

H1_Identifiability_Resolution.statement: Adding an O(1) recency-weighted threshold-offset temporal evidence state Q_t resolves the state aliasing of B0 under cyclic sub-threshold attacks (Cycle A), producing an accumulated signal Q_t that separates adversarial rehabilitation cycling from uncompromised baseline recovery.
H1_Identifiability_Resolution.testable_prediction: Under Cycle A attack replay, Q_t will accumulate across successive 1:10 attack/rest cycles, reaching a periodic orbit peak significantly higher than the benign stationary baseline Q*.
H1_Identifiability_Resolution.falsification_condition: If Q_t decays to zero within the 10-step rest window (Q_t(t=11) == Q_t(t=0)), or if the accumulated Q_t cannot be distinguished from ambient benign fluctuations.

H2_Minimality_and_Determinism.statement: The temporal evidence state Q_t can be maintained with strictly O(1) additional state (a single 32-bit floating-point register) and deterministic O(1) arithmetic updates per step, without requiring packet history buffers or external timestamps.
H2_Minimality_and_Determinism.testable_prediction: Memory overhead is bounded by 4 bytes per device state, and per-step computation requires at most 4 elementary operations (clamp, subtract, multiply, add).
H2_Minimality_and_Determinism.falsification_condition: If accurate temporal tracking requires storing past event timestamps, maintaining a ring buffer, or non-constant per-step memory.

H3_Benign_Characterizability_and_Availab.statement: There exists a parameter regime (rho, q_low) for Q_t such that its stationary distribution under pure chronological benign telemetry has a bounded upper percentile (e.g., 99th percentile), enabling the definition of an evidence threshold that maintains honest device availability without inflating false block transitions.
H3_Benign_Characterizability_and_Availab.testable_prediction: On the 17,459-step chronological benign telemetry stream, setting q_low = 0.35 places 82.56% of benign traffic in the deadband (f(A)=0), resulting in a median benign Q of 0.0000 and preventing the cascading rate collapse observed in M2.
H3_Benign_Characterizability_and_Availab.falsification_condition: If the benign telemetry contains sustained near-threshold bursts that drive Q_t above the adversarial accumulation level, causing false quarantine inflation comparable to M1 (+10.75 pp) or M2 (+4.64 pp).

roadmap_to_phase_7.step_1: Formal state-space augmentation: S_t = (T_t, E_t, SB_t, Q_t)
roadmap_to_phase_7.step_2: Coupling function definition: how Q_t interacts with trust update and quarantine gating
roadmap_to_phase_7.step_3: Two-run bit-for-bit deterministic evaluation against attack schedules A-E and 17,459 benign observations
